inlines.v: BRONZ'ITE, noun [from bronze.] A mineral, called by Hauy diallage metalloide, nearly allied to Labrador hornblend, or hyperstene. It has a yellowish brown color and semi-metallic luster, approaching to that of bronze. Bronzite is regarded by Cleaveland as a subspecies of diallage.
